items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: They had a boy called James Williams, a good band that played from uptown.

ctx.x: They go out on the boats and they.

Yeah, they see boats coming across the street. It was just that big. For them little boats. About 30 feet long. They got about 25, 30 people on the boat. and we sitting up there big and we're playing and it's going over the lake and come back. When that boat go over the lake and come back, it's time to go home. We got to go on another job. And that's the way those boats and they have about two, three hundred of them doggone boats. They all got bands on them. They ain't worried. Oh yeah, they got them little boats…
I knew him. He played with Ory out in California.
